abstract class Client {
  Future<int> send(int value);
}

Future<List<int>> sendItems(
  List<int> items,
  int width,
  Future<Client> Function() connect,
) async {
  final results = List<int?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(
    List.generate(width, (_) async {
      while (next < items.length) {
        final index = next++;
        results[index] = await (await connect()).send(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
  return results.cast<int>();
}
